name: Glitch Interpreter
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, if you control no face-down permanents, return this creature to its owner's hand and manifest dread.
Whenever one or more colorless creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, if you control no face-down permanents, return this creature to its owner's hand and manifest dread.

needs.what: manifest dread (701.62a): look at the top two cards of your library, choose one and put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 manifested creature (turnable face up for its mana cost if it is a creature card), and put the other into your graveyard -- either a `dread: true` flag on the `manifest` op or a `manifest_dread` op
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `manifest` (amount, cloak, player) always manifests the top card with no choice and sends no second card to the graveyard; `look_at_top` can choose one of two and send the rest to the graveyard, but its `face_down` means private exile and it cannot put a card onto the battlefield as a face-down manifested 2/2

needs.what: a selector/condition key matching face-down permanents (manifested, cloaked, morphed, disguised), so the intervening-if "if you control no face-down permanents" is an `exists` negated over `{zone: battlefield, controller: you, face_down: true}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `selector_keys` and `trigger_filter_keys` have no face-down key; `face_down` exists only as an option on library/exile ops meaning private exile, not as a property a selector can read on a permanent
